button-primary.css: .g-btn--primary { background: var(--brand); color: #fff; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: 12px 20px; font-family: Nunito, sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: 15px; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px var(--brand-soft); transition: transform 0.2s ease, filter 0.2s ease; } .g-btn--primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); filter: brightness(1.03); }

button-ghost.css: .g-btn--ghost { background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--ink); border: 1px solid var(--hair); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); padding: 12px 20px; }

card.css: .g-card { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--hair); border-radius: var(--radius); padding: var(--spacing-md); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.04), 0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.06); }

pill-tag.css: .g-pill { background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--muted); border: 1px solid var(--hair); border-radius: var(--radius-pill); padding: 3px 10px; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; }

icon-tile.css: .g-ic { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; width:30px; height:30px; border-radius:9px; } .g-ic--green { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--green) 15%, transparent); color: var(--green); }
